title: Package insert sections and numbers
text: Sections use the numbers and headings of the 2017 instructions. A section with nothing to say is left out, but the following sections keep their numbers: they are not moved up.

title: Required content is filled
text: The sections that apply to every prescription drug have content.

title: Header items
text: Above section 1 the insert gives the date of preparation or revision, the Standard Commodity Classification Number of Japan (87xxxx for drugs), the approval number with the date of initial marketing, storage and shelf life, the therapeutic category and the regulatory classification.
at: PSEHB Notification No. 0608-1, header items A to G

title: Warnings
text: When fatal or extremely serious, irreversible adverse reactions can occur, section 1 Warnings is filled and set apart in a box at the top.
simplified: The red frame of the Warnings box is the usual layout; the app checks that the warnings are boxed.

title: Reasons for contraindications
text: Except for hypersensitivity, each contraindication gives its rationale briefly in square brackets [ ].
